items.title: Hodges, Duncan earn Mountain West Player of the Week honors
items.summary: Air Force senior quarterback Kemper Hodges and junior punter Will Duncan earned Mountain West Player of the Week honors for their performances in Air Force's 35-26 win over UConn last week. Hodges earned offensive honors while Duncan was the special teams honoree.

items.title: Hodges Rumbles For 200 Yards To Lead Air Force To 35-26 Win Over UConn
items.summary: USAF ACADEMY, Colo. – Senior QB/FB Kemper Hodges' four touchdown game was enough to boost Air Force to a 35-26 win over the UConn Saturday afternoon at Falcon Stadium.  The win lifted the Falcons to 6-2 on the season, getting the program bowl-eligible for the first time since 2023.

items.title: Air Force Falls 28-14 at Wyoming
items.summary: Air Force football was unable to overcome a fast start by Wyoming (5-3, 4-1 MW), coupled by several costly miscues, as the Cowboys held on to a 28-14 win Friday night in Mountain West action at Jonah Field at War Memorial Stadium in Laramie, Wyo.  The loss dropped the Falcons to 5-2, 3-2 MW.
